newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Police witness has mouth wired shut by intruder.
newsitem.headline: Police witness has mouth wired shut by intruder.

text.p: An Australian man about to testify in an organised crime trial had his mouth wired shut with coathanger wire by an intruder who broke into his house, Australian newspapers reported on Wednesday.
The man also had wire pushed through both wrists and legs after being tied up, the Brisbane Courier-Mail said.

The unidentified 41-year-old lay in agony for over two hours before managing to knock a telephone to the floor and dial an emergency services number. He was released after treatment at a Brisbane hospital.

Police confirmed that a man armed with a handgun had broken into a man's house on the Gold Coast in Queensland state on Tuesday, taped his mouth shut and then pushed wire through his cheeks, wrists, knees and ankles.
But they declined to give any more details or comment on reports that the man was officially under police protection.
The victim's lawyer, Sean Cousins, told Channel Nine television the attack was probably meant as a warning.
"I can only interpret what's happened as a lesson to him and as a lesson to others who might be thinking of giving valuable information to the police," Cousins said.
